categories.name: Breach / credential-dump lookup
categories.description: Check whether an identifier (email or password hash) appears in known public breaches.

components.notes: HIBP k-anonymity: only first 5 hex chars of SHA-1 leave the machine.

categories.name: Username enumeration
categories.description: Probe a catalog of online services for an account under a given username.

components.notes: Differential 200/4xx detection; read-only GETs; uncertain reported, never guessed.

categories.name: Account-existence enumeration (reset flows)
categories.description: Differential probing of password-reset / account-existence endpoints.

components.notes: Single GET per identifier; state-changing requests capped by caller.

categories.name: Account-recovery / masked-identity reveal
categories.description: Reveal masked email/phone digits from account-recovery or profile pages.

components.notes: Differential parse of revealed digit; consent + rate-limit conditions.

categories.name: People-search / background-check aggregation
categories.description: Query whitelisted people-search sources and merge results.

components.notes: Consent-gated; one source per run (data minimisation). Multi-source aggregation pending.

categories.name: Active attack-surface scanning
categories.description: TCP/HTTP probing, service-version detection, vuln-template matching.

components.notes: TCP connect + one GET per target (read-only). Nmap/nuclei integration pending.

categories.name: Shodan / internet-wide query
categories.description: Shodan dork construction + execution for internet-exposed services.

components.notes: Dork builder + client; part of the attack-path enrichment stage.
Enrichment stage for attack-path context. No dedicated GeoIP runner yet.

categories.name: Authenticated platform scraping + contact harvesting
categories.description: Authenticated read-only GETs with email/phone extraction from HTML/JSON.

components.notes: Authed GET works; contact parsing (email/phone from HTML/JSON) pending.

categories.name: Trait/profiling-based social scoring
categories.description: Scored, explainable dossier from OSINT hits (evidence pack, not verdict engine).

components.notes: Planned. Inputs = OSINT hits from other categories; outputs = scored dossier with cited inputs.

categories.name: Credibility / evidence-reliability annotation
categories.description: Advisory reliability annotation (provenance, corroboration, recency, contradiction).

components.notes: Planned. Advisory-only — never a guilt/credibility verdict.

categories.name: Untargeted facial-image scraping
categories.description: Scrape internet/CCTV sources for face images; detect + categorise.

components.notes: Untargeted mass scraping = prohibited by default (GDPR + AI Act). Requires DPiA.

categories.name: Sensitive biometric categorisation
categories.description: Label faces by sensitivity category (public_figure, employee, minor, health, religion, general).

components.notes: Minors + special-category force DPiA + shorter retention.

categories.name: Real-time remote biometric ID in public spaces
categories.description: CCTV ingest + real-time face match against enrolled gallery.

components.notes: Prohibited without LE warrant / AI Act basis. Same for biometric-rbr.

categories.name: Cross-case / cross-agency person graphs
categories.description: Pseudonym person nodes + hash-chained events; cross-agency via ODP envelope exchange.

components.notes: SQLite store; cross-agency via ODP envelope events.
